role.description: Administrative role carried by the signed modulartess_admin_role claim. Capabilities per role are declared explicitly in ADR 0007; there is no numeric hierarchy.

priceCop.description: Whole Colombian pesos. Never a decimal: COP has no subdivision in use.

version.description: Optimistic concurrency token. Mutations require it as expectedVersion.

nextPageToken.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when there are no more.

expiresAt.description: Session expiry. There is no silent renewal: a new session requires a new sign-in.

idToken.description: Firebase ID token obtained by the admin panel client SDK and forwarded by its server-side BFF. The browser never calls this endpoint directly.

amountMinor.description: Amount in the currency minor unit. COP has exponent 0, so this equals whole pesos.

badges.description: Descriptive labels derived from backend data. Never a sales claim.

slug.description: Detail slug, or null when the product has no published detail page yet.

startingPrice.description: Null while the product has no authoritative price in the backend.

facets.description: Counts per dimension, computed ignoring the filter of that same dimension.

page.description: Effective page. A request beyond the last page is clamped to it.

description.description: Deprecated: kept only for the first published contract. Mirrors shortDescription. New consumers must read shortDescription and longDescription.

longDescription.description: Long PLAIN-TEXT description with paragraphs separated by a blank line. Will map from WooCommerce description. Never contains markup: clients must not inject it as HTML.

shortDescription.description: Short plain-text summary. Will map from WooCommerce short_description.

delta.description: Non-zero integer. The resulting stock can never go below zero.

replayed.description: True when the idempotency key had already been applied and nothing changed.

variantLabel.example: Acabado: Roble claro · Ancho: 80 cm · Espejo: Redondo

info.description: Versioned HTTP contract for the Modulartess backend. One document, two surfaces: public operations under /v1/demo and administrative operations under /v1/admin, separated by path and tag. Demo operations use mock adapters only. Administrative operations are server-to-server: the admin panel BFF calls them with a Cloud Run IAM identity token in Authorization and carries the administrative session in a separate internal header. A browser never calls this API directly.
info.title: Modulartess Backend API

get.description: Server-to-server only. Verifies the session with revocation checking on every call. Never returns nor rotates the session material.

Cache-Control.description: Always no-store on this surface, including error responses.

401.description: admin_authentication_required. One indistinguishable response for a missing, empty, malformed, oversized, expired or revoked session and a disabled user.

Cache-Control.description: Always no-store on this surface, including error responses.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the session is valid but no longer carries the administrative role.

Cache-Control.description: Always no-store on this surface, including error responses.

404.description: not_found: the administrative surface is disabled in this deployment.

Cache-Control.description: Always no-store on this surface, including error responses.

503.description: admin_auth_unavailable: the identity provider could not be reached.

Cache-Control.description: Always no-store on this surface, including error responses.

post.description: Server-to-server only: called by the admin panel BFF, never by a browser. Requires a sign-in no older than 300 seconds and the signed administrative role claim. The session material is returned only in the x-modulartess-admin-session response header and never in the body. Sessions last 28800 seconds and are not silently renewed.

201.description: Session created. The session material is in the response header, not in this body.

Cache-Control.description: Always no-store on this surface, including error responses.

x-modulartess-admin-session.description: Firebase session cookie value for the panel BFF to store as an HttpOnly __Host- cookie. Never exposed to browser JavaScript and never returned in the body.

400.description: invalid_request: the body is absent, carries unknown fields, or the idToken is malformed or out of size range.

Cache-Control.description: Always no-store on this surface, including error responses.

401.description: admin_authentication_required. One indistinguishable response for an invalid, expired or revoked token, a disabled user, and a sign-in older than 300 seconds.

Cache-Control.description: Always no-store on this surface, including error responses.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the identity is authenticated but lacks the administrative role.

Cache-Control.description: Always no-store on this surface, including error responses.

404.description: not_found: the administrative surface is disabled in this deployment.

Cache-Control.description: Always no-store on this surface, including error responses.

429.description: The exchange is rate limited to 10 requests per minute. The body is the framework throttler payload, not the standard error DTO, and a Retry-After header carries the window in seconds.

Cache-Control.description: Always no-store on this surface, including error responses.

503.description: admin_auth_unavailable: the identity provider could not be reached, or the server is misconfigured.

Cache-Control.description: Always no-store on this surface, including error responses.

get.description: Ordered by updatedAt descending. Requires products.read.

post.description: Always created as draft, whatever the body says. SKU is normalised to uppercase and both SKU and slug become immutable. Requires products.create.

get.summary: Read one product for the panel. Requires products.read.

patch.description: Requires expectedVersion. Cannot change id, sku, slug, status, stockQuantity or audit fields. Bumps version and refreshes the public projection when the product is active. Requires products.update.

post.description: Immediately withdraws its public projection. SKU and slug stay reserved: neither is reused. Requires expectedVersion and products.archive.

Non-zero integer delta with a reason. Stock never goes below zero. Repeating the same Idempotency-Key with the same body returns the same result; reusing it with a different body is a conflict. Requires expectedVersion and inventory.adjust.

parameters.description: 8-128 characters. Makes a retried adjustment safe.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

post.description: Needs name, SKU, slug and priceCop greater than zero. A product with no stock is published as out_of_stock. Requires expectedVersion and products.publish.

409.description: The idempotency key is in progress, was reused with a different payload, or belongs to an attempt that needs review

500.description: The checkout store is in an inconsistent state and needs review

503.description: Checkout is temporarily unavailable; the same idempotency key can be retried
